Hero Vida NEX 3 Electric Car Patented With Gullwing Door

KS
By Kabir Sharma Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist • via Rushlane.com Wire
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: Rushlane.com Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • Hero Vida is working on some exciting projects that extend beyond the more commonly available electric scooters and motorcycles .
  • Notable among these is the Vida Novus range, which has three mobility solutions – NEX 1, NEX 2 and NEX 3.
  • Earlier this year in June, Hero had filed a patent for NEX 2 , a self-balancing three wheeled trike.
⚡ EDITORIAL TAKE • KABIR SHARMA Indian Automotive & SUV Specialist

Bharat NCAP Safety Standards & Indian Road Readiness

In India's rapidly evolving automotive landscape, crashworthiness and real-world durability are driving consumer purchase decisions like never before. As reported by Rushlane.com, indigenous automakers like Tata Motors and Mahindra are setting global safety benchmarks while optimizing suspension and ground clearance for unpredictable road conditions.

Big Picture: Upcoming monthly FADA retail delivery reports and Bharat NCAP rating scorecards will reveal which domestic models capture mass-market dominance.

Hero Vida is working on some exciting projects that extend beyond the more commonly available electric scooters and motorcycles . Notable among these is the Vida Novus range, which has three mobility solutions – NEX 1, NEX 2 and NEX 3. Earlier this year in June, Hero had filed a patent for NEX 2 , a self-balancing three wheeled trike. Hero has now filed a patent for NEX 3, an ultra-compact electric car.

📌 The Core Development

Hero had unveiled the NEX 3 at last year’s EICMA. Most of the features seen in the design patent images are the same as those on the model showcased at EICMA. One of the key highlights is a single wing-style door that opens upwards. While this can be part of someone’s style statement, it also has functional relevance.

For example, this wing-style door can come in handy when parking the car in tight spaces. Since the door opens largely upwards, the side space requirement will be limited. The door is quite large, relative to the size of the micro car. This will allow easy ingress and egress for all passengers. In a parked scenario, the wing-style door can also provide clear views of the outside world.

🔍 Background & Sector Context

Considering the car’s compact footprint, such features will also help avoid a sense of claustrophobia that some users might experience. Hero calls the NEX 3 a micro SUV, and its exterior styling backs up that claim. At the front, NEX 3 has a V-shaped grille structure. Lighting elements appear to be vertically stacked in a trapezoidal format, flanking the grille.

A full-width LED strip is expected on the bonnet. The micro car is using large aero-optimized alloy wheels, paired with low-profile tyres. Other key features include flared wheel arches, a large window for the second-row passenger and a gently sloping roofline. At the rear, Vida NEX 3 has a distinctive hexagonal-style boot lid and a prominent bumper.

📊 Industry & Real-World Impact

Hero Vida NEX 3 is a 2-seater vehicle, designed primarily for swift mobility in modern cities. Interiors are largely minimalist, although some exciting colours have been used to perk up the cabin ambience. The micro car has a hexagonal-shaped steering wheel and a clutter-free dashboard with dual circular instrument dials.

🔮 Strategic Outlook & What Lies Ahead

Vida NEX 3 will have a customizable interior, allowing more personalization options to users. Even with its compact profile, the micro car has comfortable seating for two. While specifications for Vida NEX 3 have not been revealed, it is expected to get features like automatic AC and turn-by-turn navigation.

Though the design patent for Hero Vida NEX 3 has been filed, a specific launch timeline has not been revealed. Combining the convenience of a car and the compact profile of a two-wheeler, NEX 3 has potential to target a niche segment of buyers. With ever-increasing traffic congestion across most cities and the urgent need to reduce pollution, products like Hero Vida NEX 3 can witness sizable demand in the future.
